{{Quote|We controlled both ground and air superiority, or so we thought. Their speed, by the Force, their speed&hellip;the Hammers destroyed everything we threw at them, overrunning our forward positions, we had no choice but a tactical withdrawal.|Torv Keist|<ref name="The Battle of Turak IV">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/sourcearchive/news20090512.html|text=The Battle of Turak IV|int=The Battle of Turak IV}}</ref>}}
'''Torv Keist''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Serving in the [[Hitak Harriers]], Keist fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Hell's Hammers]] [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] unit at the [[Battle of Turak IV]]. Keist was among the survivors of the battle and was later debriefed by [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] and assisted Alliance historian [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] in detailing the events of the battle.
